1.7.29（270）统一 3D 工作台、设计流程加固与供应商/运行时交付（候选版）

• 统一 3D：画布顶部旧 3D 创建按钮已移除，底部插入菜单创建原生 .floecad 节点并打开同一全屏工作台；3D 全景仍独立。既有旧版 3D 场景不自动转换，明确首次编辑时先备份并显示已知差异。
• CAD 全屏：保留进入前的相机，不再回到默认斜视角；完成后可见视口的方向标签与缩略图/截图回调正确交还。无几何模型保存提交如实预览；保存失败保留草稿；全新模型全屏取消不再残留空草稿。
• 共享设计流程：简报/规格 → 导入或生成 → 锚定反馈 → 修订绑定候选 → 确认后采纳（同一次 CAS 更新真实节点）→ 真实解析器验证导出；四个入口共用同一服务与身份。
• 决策与发布：通知绑定候选的原始任务，先写持久意图、再确认送达，失败下次启动补送；助手采纳需明确授权；恢复保留规范字节与冻结修订。
• 供应商与运行时：配置校验与保存把本地提交和同步入队分开，拒绝半套配置；后台任务持久化对账；工具循环限制重复失败尝试，未知远端结果记录账本而不盲目重试。
• 储存与证据：分类去重计量；清理仅限任务持有的注册候选；工具图片按真实字节校验格式并恰好送达一次。

请重点测试：iPad 横竖屏/分屏、iPhone 窄屏；创建 3D 模型→切换视角→全屏改相机→完成保持；保存重开；旧版 3D 场景首次编辑迁移；设计导入→提案→采纳→导出；储存扫描/清理报告。

说明：本构建为候选版本，源码已通过聚焦模块/App 测试与本机精确源码 Release 设备构建；真机、真实模型服务与 Apple 验收仍未完成。云端 AI 需自行配置服务；设计提案需确认后才会生效。iPad 分屏与大字体交互尚未验收。
en-US:
1.7.29 (270): Unified 3D workbench, design workflow hardening, provider/runtime delivery (candidate)

• Unified 3D: the old top-of-canvas 3D controls are gone; the bottom insertion menu creates a native .floecad node and opens the same fullscreen workbench. Existing legacy 3D scenes convert only on an explicit first edit, after a recoverable backup and a known-differences disclosure.
• CAD fullscreen: the exact camera you entered with is preserved (no automatic diagonal re-fit) and, on Done, the visible viewport's orientation labels and thumbnail/screenshot providers are re-bound to the presenter. A model with no geometry commits an honest preview; a failed save keeps the recoverable draft; cancelling an untouched new model in fullscreen leaves no empty draft.
• Shared design workflow: brief/spec → import or generate → anchored feedback → revision-bound candidate → confirmed adoption that updates the real node in one CAS commit → export verified by the real parser; all four entrances share one service and identity.
• Decisions and publication: notices target the candidate's originating task, a durable intent is written before the Canvas commit, delivery is acknowledged only after durable ingress, and failed deliveries repair on next launch. Assistant adoption requires an explicit authorization step; recovery keeps canonical bytes and a frozen revision.
• Provider and runtime: configuration validation and the save runner separate local commit from sync enqueue and refuse half-applied profiles; background runs are durable and reconciled; tool-loop hardening bounds repeated failed attempts and records unknown remote outcomes instead of blind retries.
• Storage and evidence: categorized, deduplicated measurement; cleanup limited to registered task-owned candidates; tool images are format-checked against real bytes and delivered once per result.

Please test: iPad portrait/landscape/split view, iPhone compact layouts; create a 3D model → switch view → fullscreen camera change → Done preserves it; save/reopen; migrate an existing legacy 3D scene on first edit; design import → propose → adopt → export; the storage scan/cleanup report.

Limits: candidate build whose source passed focused module/App suites and a local exact-source Release device build; physical-device, real-provider and Apple acceptance remain open. Cloud AI requires your configured provider. Proposed design edits apply only after confirmation. iPad split-window and large-font interaction are not yet qualified.
